title: Samaṇā (1)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || 3 Pañcime bhikkhave upādānakkhandhā || || Katame pañca || Seyyathīdaṃ rūpupādānakkhandho || pe || Viññāṇupādānakkhandho || || 4-5 Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam na pajānanti || pe || pajānanti || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || ||
